architecture_selection: K64 R256, fixed actual M642; original bank primary and independently trained second seed
operator_selection: same recipe for both seeds; conditioned DeepONet only if expanded-development worst improves for both
classical_selection: all predeclared controls retained; within-job cost/error frontier, no final retuning

physical_reference_protocol.status: prospective; no final parameters or fields drawn

physical_reference.output_times: all 51 original output times from 0 to 0.25
physical_reference.comparison_domain: reference fields restricted by exact nodal inclusion to the 31^3 interior coarse nodes
physical_reference.normalization: fixed supplied initial-field Euclidean norm on the common coarse nodes
physical_reference.interpretation: empirical refinement checks; no rigorous continuum certificate. If either budget fails, report the discrepancy and retain the main result as same-grid evidence.
physical_reference.retention: all requested restricted fields; all Newton iterations and residuals; full native previous/current fields for the largest recorded step residual per case/level; full native initial/final fields on time-refinement cases. Full fine trajectories may be streamed, never silently omitted from a claimed full-field audit.

physical_reference_protocol.freeze_requirement: all model checkpoints, complete operator recipes, correction directions/POD basis, solver configuration and row-selection rule committed and hashed before parameter-seed access

operator_metadata.output_contract: seven learned evolved knots plus exact supplied initial field, linear time interpolation to all 51 fields
operator_metadata.normalization: each time error divided by supplied initial-field norm
operator_metadata.input: supplied initial interior field, viscosity and fixed coordinates
